payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the deep neural network models used in evaluation, including the Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model and the model from the Pytorch-tutorial by Yunjey, both of which utilize CNN and LSTM architectures.

claims.text: The Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model uses a CNN for feature extraction and LSTM for decoding.
The model from the Pytorch-tutorial by Yunjey employs ResNet-152 for encoding and LSTM for decoding.
